reason: I'm not waiting days for an online parcel of chutney when I can buy a bottle right downstairs at the kirana immediately, especially when packaged chutneys usually taste chemical.
objection: Why order online and wait 2 to 3 days when I can grab sauce from the local kirana or make it at home?
would_change_my_mind: Instant 10-minute delivery on quick commerce apps and proof that it tastes fresh.
